description: Details of Conditions 7 (Travel Plan), 8 (Delivery and Servicing Plan), 9 (Parking Management Plan) and 10 (Waste Management Plan) pursuant to planning permission reference 25/0098/FULOPDC dated 01/10/2025 for 'Erection of single storey extension to the north elevation to provide main building entrance, cafe and events space; partial demolition to enable construction of new west elevation; and installation of roof mounted ventilation flues in connections with use of the building for Class E purposes for a temporary period of 11 years, and associated car parking, cycle parking, bin storage, fencing, gate, and landscaping; and application for Advertisement Consent for installation of two associated fascia signs on north elevation.' (out of borough)
